Guideline: Use whileTap with Snappy Spring Config
Description: Framer Motion's whileTap provides instant pointerdown compression and automatic spring release on pointerup or pointercancel.
Do: Use scale: 0.965 for buttons and scale: 0.985 for larger cards with stiffness: 500, damping: 30
Don't: Use scale: 0.8 on standard buttons or omit transition spring damping
Code Good: <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.965, y: 1 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 30 }}>

Guideline: Use layoutId for Sliding Active Tab & Filter Pills
Description: layoutId automatically performs FLIP calculations between unmounting and mounting indicator pills across tabs.
Do: Put layoutId on the background pill span and keep text in a relative z-10 span above it
Don't: Put layoutId on the parent button containing text (stretches and distorts the text glyphs during transit)
Code Good: {isActive && <motion.span layoutId='tab-pill' className='absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-800 rounded-md -z-10' transition={{ type: 'spring', bounce: 0.18, duration: 0.35 }} />}

Guideline: Use layout='position' on List Items with AnimatePresence
Description: When items are added or removed from a list, layout='position' smoothly slides sibling items into their new slots without warping their aspect ratio.
Don't: Use bare layout={true} on text cards if their height changes abruptly
Code Good: <AnimatePresence mode='popLayout'>{items.map(i => <motion.li key={i.id} layout='position' exit={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }} />)}</AnimatePresence>

Guideline: Use useMotionValue and useSpring for Magnetic & Tilt Effects
Description: useMotionValue and useSpring update the DOM outside React's render cycle for 120fps magnetic buttons and 3D perspective cards.
Do: Bind pointer coordinates to useMotionValue and pipe through useSpring(val, { stiffness: 350, damping: 25 })
Don't: Drive animate={{ x: stateX, y: stateY }} from React useState on mousemove
Code Good: const x = useMotionValue(0); const springX = useSpring(x, { stiffness: 350, damping: 25 });

Description: Wrapping the app in <MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'> automatically disables transform/layout spatial animations while preserving opacity/color transitions.
Don't: Force spatial spring bounces on users with prefers-reduced-motion enabled
Code Bad: Ignoring reducedMotion in Framer Motion trees
